name: ConvexHttpClient
reason: The Convex SDK client instance is only passed along; the twin checks the constructor and auth arguments.

name: DefaultLogger
reason: A field inside the Convex SDK client, never read by the twin.

name: LiveNatsPublisher
reason: The receiver of the publisher methods; the twin reads only its recorded scalar fields.

name: Promise
reason: A promise is passed along or awaited, and its settled value appears as a later recorded effect.

name: Timeout
reason: A Node timer handle, only passed back to clearInterval or unref.

name: ^runSecretValues$
reason: Reads the secrets of the current observability scope; the twin passes the list on and checks each redaction argument.

name: ^redactWithRunSecrets$
reason: The log module scrubber; the twin checks the value and the scrub list it is given.

name: ^setInterval$
reason: The runtime timer; the twin checks the period.

name: ^clearInterval$
reason: The runtime timer; the twin checks the handle.

name: ^queuedLeaseTimer\.unref$
reason: The runtime timer; takes no input and returns nothing the twin uses.

name: ^new ConvexHttpClient$
reason: The Convex SDK constructor; the twin checks the deployment URL.

name: ^\(client as unknown as \{ setAdminAuth\(key: string\): void \}\)\.setAdminAuth$
reason: The Convex SDK accepts the deployment credential; the twin checks it is the input key.

name: ^requireEnv$
reason: Environment configuration; the twin checks the variable name and passes the value on.

name: MsgHdrsImpl
reason: The NATS headers object is passed to publish; the twin checks the single header it sets.

name: WeakMap
reason: The per-connection manager cache; only its return is passed along.

name: AccountCipher
reason: The account cipher is held, not read; decryption is a recorded effect.

name: Session
reason: A session handed to helpers; the twin reads only recorded fields.

name: ^getSharedNatsConn$
reason: Returns the process-wide NATS connection; the twin passes it on.

name: ^connection\.flush$
reason: The NATS client flushes its buffer; takes no input.

name: ^natsHeaders$
reason: The NATS SDK builds an empty headers object.

name: ^hdrs\.set$
reason: The NATS SDK stores a header; the twin checks its name and value.

name: ^connection\.publish$
reason: The NATS client sends the frame; the twin checks subject, bytes and headers.

name: ^jetstreamManagers\.(get|set)$
reason: A WeakMap cache keyed by the connection; arguments are checked and the answer is what was stored.

name: ^connection\.jetstreamManager$
reason: The NATS SDK builds a manager; the twin checks the options.

name: ^jsm\.streams ?\.(info|update|add)$
reason: JetStream stream administration; the twin checks the stream name and full config.

name: ^loader$
reason: Loads wrapped keys, Convex in production or a test double; the twin checks the account id.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: The clock is an input.

name: ^cipher\.hasKey$
reason: AccountCipher reports whether it holds the blob's key; the twin checks the blob.

name: ^runtime\.mutate$
reason: Convex validates and runs the named mutation; the twin checks name and arguments.

name: ^getStorage\(\)\.connections\.(load|saveRefreshed)$
reason: Storage reads and writes the connection row; the twin checks the arguments.

name: ^subagentCoordinator\.(drainCompletionsToParent|waitForIdle|drainCompletionsAndDetachToParent)$
reason: The coordinator drains subagent work; its own methods are modelled where they are called.

name: ^jsonResponse$
reason: Builds the HTTP response; the twin checks status and body.

name: ^errorResponse$
reason: Builds the HTTP error response; the twin checks status, message, code and headers.

name: ^errorSseResponse$
reason: Builds the event-stream error; the twin checks message and status.

name: ReadableStream
reason: The response body stream is built and handed to Response; its frames are checked as controller effects.

name: ReadableStreamDefaultController
reason: The stream controller is only told to close or enqueue, which are recorded effects.

name: ^new ReadableStream$
reason: The web stream constructor; the twin checks the source shape and handles its start callback.

name: ^controller\.close$
reason: Closes the web stream; takes no input.

name: ^publicEventIdForScope$
reason: Internal helper with its own twin; the twin checks all four arguments.

name: ^toErrorMessage$
reason: Renders an error for the log line; the twin checks it is given the caught error.
